import json
import pathlib
import re
report_dir = pathlib.Path('/home/jack/.t3/bench-runs-lanes/codex-thermo-sol61/2026-10-10-last-push-codex-thermo-sol61/att-005/clone-work/thermo-report')

entries = re.findall(r'^### (F[12]:[^\n]+)\n\n([^\n]+)', summary, re.MULTILINE)
assert len(entries) == 2
anchors = [(134, 135), (131, 135)]
findings = []
for (title, quote), (start, end) in zip(entries, anchors):
    assert quote in summary
    findings.append({'report_path': 'summary.md', 'title': title, 'quote': quote, 'file': 'FAQ.md', 'line_start': start, 'line_end': end})
index_path = report_dir / 'finding-index.json'
index_path.write_text(json.dumps({'findings': findings, 'questions': []}, indent=2) + '\n')
loaded = json.loads(index_path.read_text())
for row in loaded['findings']:
    assert row['quote'] in (report_dir / row['report_path']).read_text()
    assert '### ' + row['title'] in summary
for report in report_dir.glob('*.md'):
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', report.read_text()):
        assert (report.parent / target).exists(), (report.name, target)
print('Validated two verbatim finding locators and all report links.')
print('Report files: ' + ', '.join(sorted(p.name for p in report_dir.iterdir())))
